Karen aa4, kei4 sat6 nei5 dou1 [faan1 zo2] lei4 Hoeng1 Gong2 [jat1 dyun6] [si4 gaan3] laa1, gam2 nei5... jau5 mou5 [gwaa3 zyu6] Jing1 Gwok3 ne1? [waa6 saai3] ngo5 dei6 zi1 cin4 dou1 hai6 Jing1 Gwok3 sik1 ge3, tung4 maai4 Jing1 Gwok3 duk6 zo2 syu1 gam3 noi6 laa1... nei5 wui5 m4 wui5... [lam2 faan1 hei2] ji6 cin4 ge3 si6 ne1?
faan1 zo2: returned
dyun6: period
si4 gaan3: time span / interval
gwaa3 zyu6: miss / be attached to
waa6 saai3: heard / was told
lam2 faan1 hei2: think back / recall
Hai6 aa3 dou1 [faan1] zo2 lei4 loeng5 nin4 laa1 [ho2 ngo5 dei6]?
ho2 ngo5 dei6: for us? / we? / right?
Hai6 aa3.
Um... hai6 lo1 di1 jan4 seng4 jat6 dou1 man6 ngo5 [li1 joeng6 je5]. Keoi5 seng4 jat6 man6 ngo5: "Nei5... wui5 (m4 wui5) [m4 gwaan3] aa3?" gan1 zyu6... kei4 sat6 m4 wui5 [m4 gwaan3] lo1 ngo5 dei6.
li1 joeng6 je5: like this / this kind of thing
m4 gwaan3: not used to / not accustomed to
